text: {"label":"Cultural Responsiveness in Behavior Analysis","definition":"Work on cultural responsiveness, competence, and humility in behavior-analytic practice, research, training, and mentorship, including adapting services and materials for clients and families from diverse cultural backgrounds.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centres on culturally responsive service delivery and practitioner training, not qualitative research methods, systemic racism and justice interventions, or creativity and complex behavior."}
